rules.source: Google AI subscribers now receive 50 additional Flow credits daily
rules.target: Google AI 订阅用户现可每天额外获得 50 个 Flow 点数
来自创作者的实用工具

rules.source: Explore tools curated from the Google Flow Community. Click into the tools gallery in any project to get started!
rules.target: 探索精选自 Google Flow 社区的工具。在任意项目中打开工具库，即可开始使用！
全新推出 Gemini Omni Flash

rules.source: Cinematic realism, powerful editing, world knowledge: try our latest video generation model!
rules.target: 电影级真实感、强大的编辑能力与世界知识：试用我们最新的视频生成模型！

rules.source: Create characters and cast them anywhere.
rules.target: 创建角色，让他们出演各种故事。

rules.source: Define their look, voice, and personality once. Reference them anywhere with a simple @tag.
rules.target: 一次设定角色的外貌、声音和个性，即可通过简单的 @标签 随时引用。

rules.source: A creative partner at every step.
rules.target: 陪伴每一步创作的伙伴。

rules.source: Brainstorming, prompting, batch editing, organizing your media, and more– see what the agent can do for you.
rules.target: 从头脑风暴、编写提示词到批量编辑和整理素材，探索智能体能为你提供的帮助。
试用 Google Flow 智能体

rules.source: Your face, your voice, your story.
rules.target: 你的面容，你的声音，你的故事。

rules.source: Create an avatar (experimental feature) to star in any videos and take your storytelling to a whole new level.
rules.target: 创建虚拟形象（实验性功能），让它出演视频，拓展你的故事表达方式。

rules.source: Take Google Flow on the road.
rules.target: 随时随地使用 Google Flow。

rules.source: Create, manage, and share your creations with the new Flow App. Available first for Android; click ‘Learn More’ to download.
rules.target: 使用全新的 Flow 应用创作、管理和分享作品。目前率先支持 Android；点击“了解详情”即可下载。
